summary: This note describes A Minute with Stan Hooper, an American sitcom starring Norm Macdonald. It was produced by Bungalow 78 in association with Paramount Television and aired on Fox. The series was canceled after six of its thirteen produced episodes had aired.
one_line: A Minute with Stan Hooper is an American sitcom starring Norm Macdonald, produced by Bungalow 78 for Fox and canceled after six of thirteen episodes aired.
key_facts: A Minute with Stan Hooper, also known as Stan Hooper, is an American sitcom.
A Minute with Stan Hooper stars Norm Macdonald.
The series was a Bungalow 78 production.
The series was produced in association with Paramount Television.
The series was canceled after six of the thirteen episodes produced were aired.
